thread:
aiya-docs: opening a quick PR to add a RHEL8 example for running the HSM agent as a container on private installs. includes SELinux and firewalld notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1999

devon-ops: great. can we cover two common gotchas: 1) container needs the host PKCS#11 device mount and 2) SELinux denial on /var/lib/hsm-sockets. a short audit2allow example would help for ops teams.

aiya-docs: yes. planning to add both. lean example for mounting: `-v /var/run/hsm:/var/run/hsm:rslave` and mention `--device /dev/crypto` when present. also a systemd unit snippet for running the container as a service.

sam-docs: also add the firewalld rules we test with: `firewall-cmd --permanent --add-rich-rule='rule family=ipv4 source address="10.0.0.0/24" port port="15001" protocol="tcp" accept'` and reminder to `firewall-cmd --reload`. many customers forget zone assignment.

aiya-docs: good call. i'll include zone examples (internal vs public) and a note about masquerade when nodes sit behind NAT for sealed sites.

devon-ops: for SELinux, simplest approved policy we shipped internally was: `audit2allow -a -M redwood_hsm && semodule -i redwood_hsm.pp`. include the AVC example in the docs so people can copy/paste.

aiya-docs: adding AVC example and the audit2allow flow. i'll also call out an alternative: set the boolean `container_manage_cgroup` if folks run older container runtimes.

ci-bot: docs lint ok? 

aiya-docs: CI flagged a link to `docs/private/hsm#pkcs11-paths` as flaky — will replace with an explicit fragment id. also adding a tiny troubleshooting table: symptom -> cause -> quick fix (e.g., "HSM agent exits with code 127 -> missing PKCS#11 library in container -> bind-mount vendor library into /usr/lib/pkcs11").

sam-docs: can you include a short GPG signing example for offline bundles? we ask partner install teams to verify tarball signatures before import. something like: 
```bash
# import vendor signing key
gpg --import vendor-install.pub.gpg
# verify bundle
gpg --verify offline-bundle.tar.gz.sig offline-bundle.tar.gz
```

aiya-docs: yep, adding that under "airgap installer checklist" along with checksum commands. also mention time skew can break signature validation if cert TTLs are strict.

devon-ops: tiny nit: use `podman` examples as primary for RHEL but keep docker variants. many RHEL distros prefer podman rootless.

aiya-docs: done. pushing changes now. tagging @sam-docs for content review.

ci-bot: linkcheck failed on PR #1999  broken anchor -> will retry after push.

aiya-docs: pushed updated anchors and added a sample `redwood-hsm.service` systemd file under examples/. will request review once linkcheck clears. thanks!
